comment: Shared momentum SGD made activation and signal propagation decisive. K1039 favored A’s LeakyReLU over C’s SiLU at equal LN count. K1074 and K1006 supported normalized deep C over shallow E, although this remains a bundled architecture preference. E’s normalization and short path favored it over zero-LN D. B’s five plain SiLU blocks, with only an initial LN, made it the strongest undertraining risk; D’s residual paths supported D over B, consistent with K1015’s conditional guidance. No new general rule was established or backtested.
